project_type: ASP.NET Core Web API backend + Vanilla JavaScript SPA frontend
build_system: ASP.NET Core - backend already working, no build needed for JS changes
test_framework: Manual browser testing - no automated frontend tests available
test_command: Manual: run dotnet run, navigate to http://localhost:5250, login as member01/password, test each page
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend: dotnet run from project root. 2. Open browser to http://localhost:5250. 3. Login with member01/password (role: Member). 4. Navigate to Dashboard - verify no 'isAdmin is not defined' error. 5. Go to Gói Tập - click Hủy Gói, type 'Xác Nhận', verify button enables and cancel works without 403. 6. Go to Lịch Class (now Đặt Lịch Tập) - select day + time, submit, verify saved via MemberSchedulePreference API. 7. Go to Đăng Ký Class - verify can register for a class and see status. 8. Go to Check-in - click Check In button, verify success without 'Mã QR không hợp lệ'. 9. Go to Lịch Tập Của Tôi - verify page loads without 'renderMemberSchedule is not defined' and shows schedule grouped by day.
environment_constraints: Backend runs on http://localhost:5250. Do NOT modify any C# backend files (Controllers, Services, DAL). JWT auth required - all API calls must include Authorization: Bearer {token} header. Member credentials: member01-member20, all password 'password'. Database uses BCrypt for passwords. QRCode format in Members table: M000001-M000020.
contribution_requirements: Fix only frontend JavaScript files. Do not change backend. Maintain existing code style (no semicolons at line ends in most files). Use existing helper functions from api.js (apiFetch, showToast, formatDate, etc.) and auth.js (getUser, getRole, getMemberId, getToken). All API responses use camelCase (backend returns camelCase via DAL DTOs). Member can only access own data - backend enforces this.
key_patterns: Modal pattern: create div.gym-modal-overlay with innerHTML, append to body, remove with closest().remove(). API calls: use apiFetch(path, { method, body: JSON.stringify(data) }) - it auto-adds Auth header if token exists. Pagination: most admin views paginate, member views fetch all (pageSize=1000). Status badges: use span.badge.badge-{success|danger|info|warning|secondary}. Loading: showLoading() before API call, hideLoading() after. Toasts: showToast(message, 'success'|'error'|'info'). Date format: backend returns ISO 8601, use formatDate() or formatDateTime() helpers.
relevant_files: Controllers/CheckinController.cs (read-only, to understand POST /api/Checkin/qr body shape)
directory_structure: wwwroot/ (all static files), wwwroot/js/ (all JavaScript modules), Controllers/ (ASP.NET Core controllers - read-only), SQL2/ (database scripts - reference only)
